pictures.scene: Jan Brueghel, The Sermon on the Mount — a great wooded hillside with huge oaks and beeches spreading their canopy right across the top of the picture, and under them a vast multitude out of every rank and country, countrywomen in white caps, townsmen in ruffs and tall hats, soldiers and pilgrims and old men leaning on staves, a mother with a baby and a little dog at the front, and far in among them Jesus standing bare-headed in a pale robe with a ring of light about His head, one hand lifted as He speaks, in my first book, o theophilus, i wrote about all that jesus began to do and to teach, until the day he was taken up to heaven, after giving instructions through the holy spirit to the apostles he had chosen
pictures.name: pd_brueghel_bergrede

pictures.scene: Bloch, The Resurrection — Christ standing on the broken lid of the tomb in a long white robe with both arms thrown up and His face lifted, a ring of gold light about His head, the dark rock of the sepulchre closing in behind Him, an angel in white kneeling on the stone at either side with hands pressed together, and white lilies springing up at His feet, after his suffering, he presented himself to them with many convincing proofs that he was alive, and while they were gathered together he commanded them, do not leave jerusalem, but wait for the gift the father promised
pictures.name: pd_bloch_resurrection

pictures.scene: Giovanni Bellini, Christ Blessing — Christ standing close to us against an evening sky, risen and alive, His long dark hair falling in damp strands over His shoulders and a plaited crown of thorns still pressed down on His brow with fine gold rays springing out behind it, His lips parted as though about to speak, a plain white robe with worked gold embroidery at the neck and cuffs, His right hand lifted beside His head with the fingers drawn in to bless and His left laid across a heavy clasped book, for john baptized with water, but in a few days you will be baptized with the holy spirit, so when they came together they asked him, lord, will you at this time restore the kingdom to israel
pictures.name: pd_bellini_blessing_christ

pictures.scene: Philips Koninck, River Landscape — a whole country opened out under an enormous sky, banks of grey and violet cloud piled across the top with white sunlit heads and strips of clear blue between them, a very low pale horizon far away where the land and a broad sheet of water meet with tiny sails on it, and below that a plain running back for miles in bands, dark woods and hedges, green fields, a winding creek lying bright among the reeds, a red roofed farm among trees and a sandy track curving up out of the foreground, it is not for you to know times or seasons that the father has fixed by his own authority, but you will be my witnesses in jerusalem, and in all judea and samaria, and to the ends of the earth
pictures.name: pd_koninck_rivierlandschap

pictures.scene: Mantegna, The Ascension — Jesus standing upright on a little round cloud high in a blue sky, in a blue mantle over a red gold robe, barefoot, two fingers lifted in blessing and a slender cross-staff with a white and red banner held in His other hand, a tall oval ring of red-winged cherub heads closing round Him with a dark band of cloud behind them, and far below on the rocky ground the apostles standing in a close crowd with their faces all turned up and their hands raised, after he had said this, they watched as he was taken up, and a cloud hid him from their sight, and they were looking intently into the sky as he was going
pictures.name: pd_mantegna_ascension

pictures.scene: Bauernfeind, Jerusalem from the Mount of Olives — the whole walled city spread out pale gold in the morning light under a soft green and cream sky, the domes and towers and flat roofs crowded together behind the long tan city wall, and a company of travellers in dark coats coming up the stony track through the olive slopes in the foreground, men of galilee, why do you stand here looking into the sky, this same jesus will come back in the same way you have seen him go, then they returned to jerusalem from the mount of olives, a sabbath day's journey away
pictures.name: pd_bauernfeind_jerusalem_from_the_mount_of_olives

pictures.scene: Gottlieb, Jews Praying in the Synagogue — a synagogue packed for a feast day under low stone arches, a bearded man in a tall fur hat and a striped prayer shawl carrying the covered scroll of the Law through the press with his eyes lowered, a young man beside him in a white shawl holding his hand against his forehead, an older man standing at the reading desk with the book open before him and another bowed right down over it, a child in a flowered coat looking straight out at us, and the women leaning over the gallery rail above, when they arrived they went to the upper room where they were staying, and with one accord they all continued in prayer, along with the women and mary the mother of jesus
pictures.name: pd_gottlieb_jews_praying_on_yom_kippur

pictures.scene: Fra Angelico, Saint Peter Preaching — a fresco in clear flat colour with a green wooded mountain rising right across the upper half, white-haired Peter standing barefoot at the left in a blue tunic and a great orange cloak with his hand raised in speech, and a packed crowd of listening men and women pressed close on the right, in those days peter stood up among the brothers, a gathering of about a hundred and twenty, and said, the scripture had to be fulfilled which the holy spirit foretold through the mouth of david concerning judas
pictures.name: pd_fra_angelico_saint_peter_preaching

pictures.scene: Vincent van Gogh, Ploughed Fields (The Furrows) — a wide field of turned earth running in long pale furrows to a line of trees and farm roofs at the far edge, a ploughman and his horse small against the horizon, two thick white clouds laid on a blue sky above, and nothing else in all that ground, he was one of our number and shared in this ministry, now with the reward for his wickedness judas bought a field, and there he fell headlong
pictures.name: pd_van_gogh_ploughed_fields_the_furrows

pictures.scene: Julius von Klever, Winter Landscape — a low cottage buried under deep snow with a dead tree twisting up over its roof, a frozen stream in front of it and the sun sinking small and pale into a yellow sky, no one on the road and no one at the door, this became known to all who lived in jerusalem, so they called that field akeldama, that is, field of blood, for it is written in the book of psalms, may his place be deserted, let there be no one to dwell in it
pictures.name: pd_klever_winterlandschap_met_brug

pictures.scene: Eugene Burnand, The Disciples Peter and John Running to the Tomb — two men running side by side into the dawn wind in warm sepia, the younger in a pale cloak with his hands clasped tight at his breast and his hair blown back, the older grey-bearded and wide-eyed beside him in a dark robe with his hand held up against his chest, both faces strained forward toward something out of the picture, therefore it is necessary to choose one of the men who have accompanied us the whole time the lord jesus went in and out among us, for one of these must become a witness with us of his resurrection
pictures.name: pd_burnand_disciples_running

pictures.scene: Pietro Perugino, The Ascension of Christ — the apostles standing on green grass before a wide blue country with Mary praying in the middle of them and Peter and Paul on either side, every face turned up and every hand joined or opened toward the red robe and bare feet of Christ carried above them in rings of winged cherub heads, so they proposed two men, joseph called barsabbas and matthias, and they prayed, lord, you know everyone's heart, show us which of these two you have chosen
pictures.name: pd_perugino_the_ascension_of_christ

pictures.scene: Huchtenburgh, Casting Lots — soldiers throwing dice on the head of a drum, one kneeling at the side in a loose white shirt reaching in toward the dice while another in a cream doublet and yellow breeches points down at them, a dozen more in wide-brimmed black hats and a blue coat with an orange sash crowding round with their pikes, a dark cloak with a red lining thrown down on the bare earth in front and a ruined tan tower rising behind, to take up this ministry and apostleship which judas abandoned, then they cast lots, and the lot fell to matthias, so he was added to the eleven apostles
pictures.name: pd_huchtenburgh_dobbelspel_om_het_leven

lines.text: In my first book, O Theophilus, I wrote about all that Jesus began to do and to teach,
until the day He was taken up to heaven, after giving instructions through the Holy Spirit to the apostles He had chosen.
After His suffering, He presented Himself to them with many convincing proofs that He was alive. He appeared to them over a span of forty days and spoke about the kingdom of God.
And while they were gathered together, He commanded them: Do not leave Jerusalem, but wait for the gift the Father promised, which you have heard Me discuss.
For John baptized with water, but in a few days you will be baptized with the Holy Spirit.
So when they came together, they asked Him, Lord, will You at this time restore the kingdom to Israel?
Jesus replied, It is not for you to know times or seasons that the Father has fixed by His own authority.
But you will receive power when the Holy Spirit comes upon you, and you will be My witnesses in Jerusalem, and in all Judea and Samaria, and to the ends of the earth.
After He had said this, they watched as He was taken up, and a cloud hid Him from their sight.
They were looking intently into the sky as He was going, when suddenly two men dressed in white stood beside them.
Men of Galilee, they said, why do you stand here looking into the sky? This same Jesus, who has been taken from you into heaven, will come back in the same way you have seen Him go into heaven.
Then they returned to Jerusalem from the Mount of Olives, which is near the city, a Sabbath day's journey away.

When they arrived, they went to the upper room where they were staying: Peter and John, James and Andrew, Philip and Thomas, Bartholomew and Matthew, James son of Alphaeus, Simon the Zealot, and Judas son of James.
With one accord they all continued in prayer, along with the women and Mary the mother of Jesus, and with His brothers.
In those days Peter stood up among the brothers, a gathering of about a hundred and twenty, and said,
Brothers, the Scripture had to be fulfilled which the Holy Spirit foretold through the mouth of David concerning Judas, who became a guide for those who arrested Jesus.
He was one of our number and shared in this ministry.
Now with the reward for his wickedness Judas bought a field; there he fell headlong and burst open in the middle, and all his intestines spilled out.
This became known to all who lived in Jerusalem, so they called that field in their own language Akeldama, that is, Field of Blood.
For it is written in the book of Psalms: May his place be deserted; let there be no one to dwell in it, and, May another take his position.
Therefore it is necessary to choose one of the men who have accompanied us the whole time the Lord Jesus went in and out among us,
beginning from John's baptism until the day Jesus was taken up from us. For one of these must become a witness with us of His resurrection.
So they proposed two men: Joseph called Barsabbas (also known as Justus) and Matthias.
And they prayed, Lord, You know everyone's heart. Show us which of these two You have chosen
to take up this ministry and apostleship, which Judas abandoned to go to his rightful place.
Then they cast lots, and the lot fell to Matthias; so he was added to the eleven apostles.
